title: Global Oils and Foot Accessories — Authentic Description Catalog
purpose: A detailed catalog dataset for a foot-care, botanical, and aromatherapy-inspired collection. Descriptions distinguish material types, explain practical accessory use, and avoid medical claims.
important_limitations: Country and region references describe known producing or cultural contexts for a material, not a verified origin claim for a particular product. Botanical names, extraction method, chemotype, allergen profile, authenticity, and permitted use level must be verified from current supplier documentation.
general_safety: Essential oils and other concentrated aromatic materials should not be ingested.
Do not apply concentrated aromatic materials undiluted to skin and do not add them directly to bathwater.
Use only properly formulated products on intact skin and follow the product label.
Stop use for burning, rash, itching, or other irritation.
People with diabetes, neuropathy, poor circulation, open sores, infection, or significant skin conditions should seek individualized clinical advice before DIY foot treatments.
Keep feet clean and dry thoroughly after any soak, especially between toes.
